mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP3A4 metabolism of prednisolone and potentiate immunosuppressive effects, while both agents have anti-inflammatory properties that could be additive or result in excessive immunosuppression.
action: Monitor for signs of excessive immunosuppression or prednisolone toxicity; consider dose adjustment if high-dose turmeric supplementation is used concurrently with prednisolone.
